about.name: Zoned Energy Estimator for Labs
about.summary: Zone energy intensities for a 115,000 sf STEM laboratory prototype, simulated in IES:VE in 2019 and allocated to zones by flow share. For early planning and proposal work: the output conveys ideas, it does not predict savings.
about.study: Quantifying Zoned Energy Approaches for Academic Science Buildings, I2SL 2019

studies.label: Climate comparison
studies.description: The baseline building in five climate zones.

studies.label: Measure study
studies.description: Six energy conservation measures and one reverse measure, all at 5A Boston. Measures were not simulated in the other climate zones and are never interpolated across them.

cases.label: Baseline
cases.description: 60% window-to-wall, labs at 6 ACH day and 2 ACH night, open-lab receptacles at 8 W/sf, night turndown to one third flow.

cases.label: Plug load reduction
cases.description: Open lab receptacle load reduced from 8 to 4 W/sf.

cases.label: Air change rate reduction
cases.description: Lab peak air change rate reduced from 6 to 4 ACH; vivarium reduced to 8 ACH.

cases.label: Separate write-up space
cases.description: Write-up space moved off the lab air handler onto the general one.

cases.label: Glazing reduced
cases.description: Office window-to-wall ratio reduced from 60% to under 40%.
cases.note: The workbook Read Me states this measure the other way round. The 2019 presentation sets the baseline at 60% (slide 21) and names the measure "Glazing Reduced to <40%" (slide 29); the presentation governs.

cases.label: Cascade air system
cases.description: Office return air cascaded to serve the labs.
cases.note: The Climate Zones workbook holds a hidden sheet of the same name with different figures. It feeds nothing and disagrees with the published results, so the measure workbook is treated as authoritative.

cases.label: External shading
cases.description: External shading added to the office facade.
cases.note: The sheet title duplicates ECM 4’s. Slide 29 of the 2019 presentation names this measure External Shading. The Climate Zones workbook holds a hidden sheet of the same name with different figures. It feeds nothing and disagrees with the published results, so the measure workbook is treated as authoritative.

cases.label: Night turndown removed
cases.description: Unoccupied setback removed — labs held at 6 ACH overnight instead of 2.
cases.note: A reverse measure. It raises energy use, and is included to show what the baseline control is worth.

validation.note: Residuals as published were computed against the baseline intensities held on this sheet, which predate the final 5A revision. Recomputing against the shipped baseline moves every residual — see docs/extraction.md.
